Sandbox_medWorks_RequireRecoveryKnowledg: Read the field-safety magazine and anatomical recovery manual before recovering parts. Does not authorize surgery on living patients.
Sandbox_medWorks_EnableCorpseRecovery_to: Allow timed recovery from corpses with preserved anatomy and provenance. Requires a carried working saw.
Sandbox_medWorks_CorpseRecoverySeconds_t: Time for each recovered part. Movement cancels the action without consuming anatomy.
Sandbox_medWorks_ExaminationMaxBodyParts: Technical safety limit per examination provider. Higher values support expanded anatomy but increase work per examination.
Sandbox_medWorks_EnableExaminations_tool: Add a timed read-only examination option to the vanilla health-panel body-part menu.
Sandbox_medWorks_ExaminationSeconds_tool: Base duration before medWorks reports current observable findings.
